active_checks.source: Start from input/initial.blend. Use the single reference image. Preserve all scene data outside the changes explicitly allowed above, including cameras and render/color settings. Render main.png from the supplied camera. Duplicate that camera and move it 0.30 m along its local positive X axis without changing lens or rotation to render alternate.png. Keep both cameras in the same edited scene. Pack all dependencies. Hidden details may be completed plausibly.

Two luminous outline signs are missing from the corridor: the large duck outline on the near left wall and the smaller animal-face outline farther down the passage. Rebuild their continuous tubular curves, open interior spaces and distinct colored segments to match input/reference.png. Use the walls and remaining trim lights to recover placement, thickness and relative scale. Recreate their surface emission so that they illuminate nearby surfaces naturally; do not add separate lights to imitate the glow. Preserve the corridor, pipes, cables, screens, furniture, all existing lights and camera settings. Only the missing sign geometry and its materials may be added.

score_aggregation_note:
## 当前复评口径：v8 / Strict fidelity review

仅复评原作品，未改动原生成题面。逐题原图/文本特征；主视图必查，跨视图项必须核对所有公开原图和候选双视图。
每项列出达成、差异和严重度后评0–4级；主要缺陷最多2级，主体错误/缺失0级，不能因制作精致掩盖不忠于参考。
保持原总权重及自动/物理测量：Brief VLM60/测量30/物理10；Edit 数值20/目标30/保持20/物理10/VLM20；Reference 图像50/定位20/物理10/VLM20。
定位沿用原冻结参考框及公式，重新独立识别候选框。禁止任意配准。未展示仅扣对应项；技术失败不补零。
机器草案和裁判尚待人工校准，不声称人工认证。详见 harness/vlm_spec.json。
